latestTerminalSummary:
No actionable P1/P2 blockers found.

Reviewed exact committed source **`009b5d92529792b0db32798407cf56c25416beb5`**, including repository guidance, baseline sources/tests, configuration, protocol, quote and resource-guard dependencies.

All three R13 findings are addressed in the guarded launcher:

- Canonical configuration path and committed-byte checks prevent input, seed and budget substitution; checks repeat before each heavy stage.
- A campaign-wide exclusive, fsynced claim prevents alternate-output-root launches and terminal retries. The separate worker claim binds execution to the launcher parent and prevents duplicate worker admission.
- Darwin, authorized checkout and Apple M4 checks precede claiming/execution; competing-worker admission now includes CPU usage.

The outcome-blind 2× quote, pre-outcome count freeze, sequential family guard, pairing, RNG-neutral telemetry, replay and deterministic reproduction remain consistent with the brief. Relevant recovery/training sources remain unchanged from **`c4058b7f14a6df85e01f8354de676091572ab1bc`**; model pins match the indexed manifest.

Limits: static read-only review only. No edits, tests, builds, SSH, model loading, outcome inspection, training or merge. Runtime guard behavior, execution evidence, upload acceptance and green CI were not independently verified. PR197 remains open and unmerged.
